Added `rotate_token_with_retry` as a new function rather than modifying the existing `rotate_token`. This keeps the existing function intact so PR #482's retry-window and legacy-client changes to `rotate_token` won't conflict with this addition. The new function wraps `rotate_token`, calls `should_retry_rotation` on the underlying cause, and retries up to `max_attempts` times.
